verdict.rationale: The Division's own pages say businesses can file returns online through the Delaware Taxpayer Portal, pay electronically by card or bank transfer, file and pay withholding tax online, and register or renew business licenses online. A live probe confirmed the portal at tax.delaware.gov responds, with filings behind an authenticated session. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that a transaction completes end-to-end, and clarity on whether amendments and Request for Change forms can also be done online.
